GOALLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLL!! JUST LIKE THAT, FIORENTINA LEVEL THE SCORELINE! 1-1!! Jimenez receives a pass just outside the box before aiming for goal. The Spaniard's effort deflects off Marin, and flies into the bottom-right corner! Milinkovic-Savic had no chance of saving that!

GOALLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLL!!! NAPOLI NOW TAKE THE LEAD!!!! 1-0!! From the resulting corner, Politano sends a left-wing delivery into the box, with an unmarked Gilmour expertly guiding a volley into the bottom-right corner!

WELL, WELL, WELL! A NIGHTMARE FOR NYLAND AS PORTUGAL RETAKE THE LEAD!!! 2-1!!!! The Norway goalkeeper looks to play a pass forward, but it's intercepted by Ramos, who shows the composure to lift a finish into the gaping net! Just like that, the home supporters have gone quiet!

GOALLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLL!!!! NORWAY LEVEL THE SCORELINE!!! IT'S HAALAND WHO MAKES IT 1-1!!!! Odegaard steps up to take the 25-yard free-kick with Diogo Costa making a save. However, it falls into the path of Berg, who cushions back a header with Haaland prodding home from close range! That equaliser is DESERVED!

GOALLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLL!!!! PORTUGAL TAKE THE LEAD!!! 1-0!!! Mendes wriggles away from the Norway defence before playing it to Neto down the left. The winger races to the byline before picking out Joao Felix on the edge of the box. The attacker takes a touch before placing a finish into the bottom-left corner! Brilliant from the visitors!

Events.Description: GOOOOOOOAAAAAAAAALLLLLLLLLLLLL!!!! MAN CITY LEAD 5-3! After a VAR review, Haaland's goal is given! It was initially chalked off due to an apparent offside, but his far-post slide to finish Gvardiol's low cross was perfectly legal! Surely that secures a seventh straight win for City?

GOOOOOOOOAAAAAAAAAALLLLLLLLLLLLLL!!!!! BROBBEY BAGS A HAT-TRICK! Jaws are dropping open at the Etihad; that's already the seventh goal of this game! Xhaka's killer pass over the top picks out Angulo, who guides a low cross past Donnarumma, and Brobbey pokes home from close range. Remarkably, it's now 4-3 to Manchester City, and Sunderland are still in this!

GOOOOOOOAAAAAAAAAALLLLLLLLLLLLL!!!! SEMENYO STRIKES AGAIN! Cherki sends a searching ball forward from the centre-circle, causing havoc in Sunderland's defence. Two defenders collide, and the ball loops past Haaland into the path of Semenyo. Much like his finish before the break, the Man City winger plants a powerful shot into the bottom corner! It's now 4-2 to City!

GOOOOOOOOOOOOAAAAAAAAAAAAAALLLLLLLLLLLLLL!!!!!! CITY LEAD AGAIN! It's 3-2 to the hosts in Manchester! Semenyo's cross from the left is aimed towards Haaland, who lurks with menace at the back post. City play the subsequent corner-kick short, and after a prolonged spell of pressure, the ball falls nicely for Semenyo via Guehi. With a first-time strike, the Ghana international drills it firmly into the bottom-right corner!

GOOOOOOOOAAAAAAAAAAALLLLLL!!!!! SUNDERLAND STRIKE BACK ONCE AGAIN! It's now 2-2 at the Etihad! Linking up with Le Fee on the right side of the area, Meunier plays a short pass for Brobbey to convert from close range! The Black Cats claw their way back into the contest, and Brobbey's bagged a brace!

GOOOOOOAAAAAAAALLLLLLL!!! MAN CITY RESTORE THEIR LEAD! A stray pass out from the back by Danso is cut out, and Man City ruthlessly pounce. Semenyo ultimately tees up Cherki to strike, and the French wizard nets his third Premier League goal of the season. He picks out the bottom-left corner: 2-1!

GOOOOOOOOOAAAAAAAAAALLLLLLLLLLL!!!!! SUNDERLAND HIT STRAIGHT BACK! It's suddenly 1-1 at the Etihad! Played in by Le Fee, Brobbey still has plenty to do, but his first touch is sublime, opening up a clear chance to shoot. He then does so with the outside of his boot, guiding a low finish past Donnarumma!

GOOOOOOAAAAAAAAAAALLLLLLLLLLLL!!!! MAN CITY LEAD 1-0! It's a cheeky free-kick by Enzo Fernandez! What a way to score his first goal for the club! With a curling shot inside the near post, he beats Roefs from an improbable angle on the right edge of the area!

Events.Description: SAN DIEGO RESTORE PARITY WITH EIGHT MINUTES TO GO! 2-2! Inter Miami don’t react as San Diego take the free-kick in midfield short to Tverskov, who is allowed to take a few touches to get inside the opposition’s half. Spotting the defence flat-footed, the captain uses the space he’s afforded to hit a pass that finds its way through the lines before reaching the foot of Dreyer, who settles it before converting with his left at close range!

COMEBACK COMPLETE! 2-1 INTER MIAMI! Berterame is brought down just outside the penalty area after a slaloming run, but with the ball at the foot of De Paul, the referee allows play to continue. After taking a second to ensure a whistle was not forthcoming, the Argentina midfielder spots the lean of Suarez and plays an incisive pass through the lines for the striker, who drops his shoulder and fires a first-time effort with his right foot past Dos Santos at the near post!

THE BALL FINDS ITS WAY IN! WE’RE LEVEL AT NU STADIUM! 1-1! Messi wraps his left boot around the free-kick and looks to be searching for a team-mate inside the six-yard box towards the far post, but it doesn’t require a touch as the ball curls back towards the frame of the goal and sneaks past the unaware goalkeeper for an equaliser!

A GOAL OUT OF NOWHERE GIVES THE VISITORS THE LEAD! 1-0 SAN DIEGO! Tverskov receives a pass from Duah in a pocket of space 35 yards from his own goal and stretches out to poke a fantastically weighted pass through the lines for the well-timed run of Dreyer. In behind both Casemiro and Falcon, the winger takes possession in his stride before drawing St. Clair off his line to apply a chipped finish!
